description: Land Title Settlement Department - Agbopura, Hingurakgoda D/S Division, Polonnaruwa District - Cad. Map No. 120147
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of title determinations for specific land parcels, including parcel numbers, owner details, extent of land, and title classifications. The content focuses on land ownership registration and title settlement, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
